cards.title: Exact hard-support tensor discrimination and sharp energy-level gain
cards.status: self-contained internal theorem candidate; independent proof audits; external priority/correctness unverified
cards.input: known finite-dimensional E>0, E<=I, pure-null ground, one additive H hard support; parallel uses
cards.result: Energy-ordered Cholesky gives exact finite compressed-inverse norm; tilted single-matrix variational formula with uniform O(log n) remainder; sharp supremum of free-use entanglement gain equals number of distinct positive energy levels.
cards.cost_boundary: Input support budget only; no ancillary/adaptive/nonzero-false-alarm or total preparation-work extension. Fixed dimension constants and matrix acquisition/bit precision separate.
cards.next: Exact-contract external proof/priority audit; finite false-alarm and full preparation-cost extension.

cards.title: Rare projected-Slater state preparation with acquired prefix counts
cards.status: conditional transfer theorem; imported FPRAS partially audited, not independently validated or implemented
cards.input: Explicit rational-complex m-by-r Slater matrix and disjoint mode block occupation quotas summing r
cards.result: Exact zero detection; poly-bit norm/Born access; randomized poly-size quantum preparation and bounded sparse-observable estimation, with no inverse projection-success parameter. Coherent counting accuracy dependence epsilon^-2.
cards.dependency: Chen-Liu arXiv2610.06724v1 Theorem5.1 and RemarkA.4; established Grover-Rudolph preparation and amplitude-ratio primitives credited.
cards.cost_boundary: Every-execution bit bound and coherent prefix program required; very high polynomial; no BCS/Pfaffian or arbitrary coherent sums; no ground-state optimization/gap.
cards.next: Validate/implement import, then reversible circuit; resolve full Gaussian paired boundary with actual reduction.

cards.title: Probability-free all-Gaussian photon-herald energy and tail bounds
cards.status: internal analytic theorem candidate; independent domain/covariance/ladder audit passed
cards.input: Finite-mode physical Gaussian state, arbitrary phases/mixedness/displacement, original mean photon energy E, feasible specified h-photon herald
cards.result: Mean O(h(1+E)+E^2); cutoff O((1+E)(h+log(1/delta))+E^2), with explicit constants; E^2 and hE necessary at fixed error. Positive-kernel linear-E improvement.
cards.cost_boundary: No inverse herald probability; output Fock dimension may exponential; not fast arbitrary-phase simulation.
cards.next: External priority/domain proof audit; use in certified truncation, with dimension/runtime charged.
